name: @shrubbery/emporium
description: The EMPORIUM app — a DEDICATED Vite product shell (the 4th shell after garden desktop / cloud-2 cell SPA / choreograph Studio) for the live vocab-pack catalogue. Defaults to the Emporium skin (purple, Diatype, square, tight). Reuses the shrubbery library + the shell-side live /emporium read (@shrubbery/source's './emporium' subpath — U10 migration). NO backend in the library, NO mocks — reads a REAL gardend cell over the /cell proxy.
